messages:

Subject: DPA + SOC2 evidence request for pilot

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked what they saw. Procurement and legal at HealthSpan are asking us to run a DPA and provide SOC2 evidence before we can proceed to the pilot PO.

Can you:
- Share a draft DPA we can review (we'll supply redlines)
- Provide SOC2 attestation and SIG/CAIQ status (or a point of contact for the questionnaire)
- Confirm the signature routing you expect (single-signer or multi-signer, DocuSign accepted?)

We'd like to turn this in to procurement by 2028-09-29 if possible. I attached HealthSpan's SIG checklist and our standard redline expectations (for context).

Attachments: HealthSpan_SIG_checklist.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Elena Gomez
Legal Counsel | HealthSpan Inc.

Date: 2028-09-19T09:07:00-07:00

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline.

Short answers up front:
- Draft DPA: attached (Redwood_DPA_draft_v1_redline.docx). Please add redlines and return.
- SOC2 & SIG: attaching our SOC2 attestation and a link to our SIG response; happy to run through any SIG questions with your team.
- Signature routing: DocuSign is preferred; typical route at Redwood is Legal (GC) -> Commercial (VP Sales) -> Exec (if required for non-standard terms). We can make this a two-step flow (GC sign only) if HealthSpan prefers.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send back redlines by 2028-09-25 so procurement can review.
2) We do an internal legal + sales review and return a counter by 2028-09-27.
3) Execute via DocuSign the week of 2028-09-30.

CCing Karthik (legal) and Marissa (contracts/ops) to pick up the review and confirm signature lane.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft_v1_redline.docx, SOC2_Attestation_Redwood_2028.pdf

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@healthspan.com>
Date: 2028-09-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + SOC2 evidence request for pilot — legal review notes

On Tue, Sep 19, 2028 at 09:07, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline.
> 
> Short answers up front...

Team — quick legal run-through of the draft attached. High-level flagged items for negotiation:
1) Data retention: HealthSpan's initial note implied a 7-year retention in their redline template. That's outside our standard operational retention for customer content (we typically do 1 year for backups/logs, 90 days for user content after termination unless otherwise scoped). If HealthSpan insists on 7 years we need exec approval and a carveout for increased storage/cost.
2) SCCs/cross-border: we can accept standard EU SCCs but need to confirm subprocessors and whether HealthSpan requires EU-only processing. Our Private offering can do EU-only; hosted will need SCCs + Trans-Atlantic safeguards.
3) Subprocessor visibility: propose a rolling subprocessor list and 30-day notice for additions. HealthSpan's redline wanted prior consent; we should offer notice + option to object for critical categories.

I attached a redline that marks these points and proposes compromise language (retention cap at 3 years for pilot with option to extend post-PoC).

I'll defer signature routing to Marissa — but legal is fine with DocuSign; if HealthSpan requires multiple corporate sign-offs we'll surface to execs.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_legal_redline_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@healthspan.com>, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + SOC2 evidence request for pilot — signer matrix & ops checklist

Elena / team — quick ops note on signatures and evidence handoff.

Proposed signer matrix (standard):
- Redwood: General Counsel (primary signer) -> VP Commercial (secondary, countersign if non-standard monetary/commitment terms)
- HealthSpan: Legal Counsel (Elena) -> Procurement (Matt Turner PO) or CFO for exec exceptions

DocuSign flow options:
A) Single-step: Redwood GC signs, then HealthSpan signs (fastest)
B) Two-step: Redwood GC signs, Redwood Exec signs (CEO/CFO) for non-standard retention or liability changes, then HealthSpan signs (for escalated terms)

Evidence we will provide alongside the DPA: SOC2_Attestation_Redwood_2028.pdf, summary SIG export (we can share selective full SIG workbook under NDA), CAIQ snapshot on request. Please confirm which SIG sections are highest priority (security operations, access controls, data residency).

Attachment: DPA_signature_checklist.pdf

If procurement needs a PO before signature, that is fine — we can hold the DocuSign envelope pending PO number.

-Marissa Cole
Contracts & Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA_signature_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@healthspan.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthspan.com, matt.turner@healthspan.com
Date: 2028-09-19T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & evidence path for pilot — HealthSpan redlines attached

Thanks everyone. Attached are HealthSpan's redlines (HealthSpan_DPA_requested_redlines_v1.docx) — key asks summarized here:
- Retention: HealthSpan requires 7 years for records related to patient-care integration (per our compliance folks).
- On-premise segregation: for certain PHI-derived artifacts they prefer an option for EU/US on-prem or tenant isolation; request for an addendum if Redwood cannot guarantee on-prem.
- Liability cap: they want an increased cap for data incidents specific to patient data.

Procurement note: we usually issue a PO once we have a signed DPA that aligns to our security baseline. We can accelerate review if you can do a quick counter within 48 hours.

Attachments: HealthSpan_DPA_requested_redlines_v1.docx (docx)

Best,
Elena

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@healthspan.com>, procurement@healthspan.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & evidence path for pilot — proposal and next steps

Elena — thank you for the quick turnaround and the clear redlines. I discussed Karthik's notes with leadership this morning. Proposed compromise to keep the deal moving:

1) Retention: agree to a 3-year default retention for the pilot (production data), with a documented option to extend to 7 years for specific patient-care records if HealthSpan has an approved addendum and agrees to the incremental cost. This gets both compliance comfort and a narrowly scoped commercial path for longer retention.

2) On-prem/tenant isolation: offer is to evaluate Customer Private deployment for tenant isolation if HealthSpan requires it for PHI-derived artifacts; for the pilot we can provide encryption-at-rest, strict RBAC, and documented subprocessors.

3) Liability: we'll accept a higher per-incident cap for substantiated PHI incidents limited to direct damages and subject to mutual insurance limits; Karthik to propose specific language.

4) Signature routing & timing:
- We can do the single-step DocuSign GC-first flow if HealthSpan is OK with the 3-year pilot retention compromise.
- If HealthSpan requires 7-year retention without a commercial addendum, Redwood will escalate to Exec signature which will add a 48–72 hour approvals window.

Next steps (timeline):
- Karthik will post legal redline counter (incl. proposed liability language) by EOD 2028-09-20.
- Marissa to prepare DocuSign envelope and checklist pending final language.
- Elena/procurement to confirm if PO will be issued before or after signature.

If that works, we should be able to have an executed DPA and PO in hand the week of 2028-09-30 and begin the pilot immediately after.

Thanks — I appreciate the fast collaboration.

Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
